description: We are first year students of Computer Engineering from Ukraine. We are students of Chernivtsi National University. Our goal is to convey emotions through games and game design, we find it truly fascinating.
summary:
The team known as bookroot, which I am apart of, has developed a Demo, or rather, an Alpha version of a game named Space Aeneda. It's a project made specifically for this challenge, made to show a different perspective on a rather bland and uninteresting field of space mission design.
   It adresses the usual idea of a game where you design and fly different vehicles in space, in a slightly unusual way - by being a deck builder. While being just an alpha, it already has quite a few a cards (20 if we're being specific), and a few random events that may occur on the launch/flight/landing. Putting the whole gimmick aside, it also has a bit of a story going on, but unfortunately it was almost fully unused due to the lack of time.
  Going back to the gameplay, you start with a budget and choose the cards to fit in the said budget, but to also make the best possible rocket while staying in profit. Of course, building your own rocket isn't easy, you have to choose your engines, your rocket body material, what software does the rocket have, communication and even your electrical system! There's also a mass mechanic, making you choose better engines and therefore making you spend more of your budget.
  For this project, we've learnt how to make music using different apps (Yes, it's either sample or made by us!), which makes this game important not only to the team, but to me specifically. I understand that there are countless others, and I do hope our little game stands out.
details: The project was made by 6 unpaid University students on a crisp budget of 0 dollars and 0 cents. Our project was written on a pretty known game engine - Godot, using none other than it's own godot script. For the visuals we used 3DS Max and Adobe Substance for 3D, Krita for 2D and Ableton for music. The intented impact of the project is very simple - to bestow a general public of young people aged 14-18 with a knowledge of basic rocket design, through a causal entertaining card game. Regarding the creativity of the game, all things considered, it IS creative because of one simple thing - it was made solely by us. We learnt new things like godot script or how to create music using Ableton, putting in not only time but passion. It is creative because we decided to mix something not so often mixed together - a game about rocket engineering and a card game! A big factor that our team has considered is the posibility of game being too complicated, so we've triend to make the gameplay as casual as possible.
